summary: Frontend-only regression for crypto wallet top-up 13-coin fix. Logged in as buyer@nameword.local, opened /wallet, clicked Top Up. All 13 required coin buttons are present in [data-testid='topup-currency-group'] each with an SVG icon and ticker+network hint: BCH, BTC, DOGE, ETH, LTC, POLYGON, SOL, TRX, USDC-ERC20, USDT-ERC20, USDT-POLYGON, USDT-TRC20, XRP. Modal is NOT stuck on 'Loading coins…' and there is no legacy <select>. Grid renders 4-per-row on desktop as expected. End-to-end address generation was verified with a non-original coin (LTC) hitting the REAL DynoPay API: address 'LfqPPFjw5vj3KR57RbJAxmrFqHoY6hBLk9', crypto amount '0.22299444 LTC' — pay screen shows QR, network 'Litecoin', copy buttons, and [data-testid='topup-address'] / [data-testid='topup-amount-crypto'] populated correctly. Regression on 'Recent top-ups' history ([data-testid='topup-history']) also passes: rows render with coin icons and status badges (Pending / Expired / Failed) and no console errors on the wallet page.

minor.issue: DynoPay returned 500 'XRP_MASTER wallet record not found in DB. Cannot create tag-based address.' This is a DynoPay merchant-side configuration issue (missing XRP master wallet in DynoPay), not our code. XRP button is correctly displayed; other 12 coins work. Consider surfacing DynoPay error message to the user in the modal (currently just fails silently).

integration_issues.issue: Frontend shows nothing user-visible when DynoPay 500s on XRP — no toast/error text near the Generate button. UX nit only.

action_items: (Optional) Show inline error toast/message in wallet modal when /wallet/crypto-topup returns an error so users understand why 'Get address' didn't advance (currently only 500 in console).
(Merchant-side, not code) DynoPay account needs an XRP_MASTER wallet configured for XRP tag-based addresses to work; alternatively hide XRP via CRYPTO_TOPUP_COINS env until fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: Consider handling DynoPay error responses in WalletController.createCryptoTopup and returning a user-friendly message field the frontend already renders; today the axios 500 has no UX surface.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 confirmed the 13-coin modal fix. LTC verified end-to-end via real DynoPay. XRP fails at DynoPay (missing XRP_MASTER wallet) — not a frontend bug. If E1 adds a user-visible error surface for /wallet/crypto-topup failures, retest by picking XRP and confirming an error toast appears.
rca of the issue: N/A — original bug (only 3 coins shown) is fixed. XRP 500 root cause: DynoPay merchant account is missing an XRP_MASTER wallet record required for tag-based address generation. Response body: {"success":false,"message":"XRP_MASTER wallet record not found in DB. Cannot create tag-based address."}
